newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank Audi hits new high in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank Audi hits new high in Beirut.

text.p: Banque Audi hit a new high in mixed trade on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
The LIBX rose 0.16 percent to 167.15. The LISPI general index climbed 0.04 percent to 89.65 and the BLOM general index dropped 0.29 percent to 948.72.
Turnover fell to 264,641 shares from 317,827 for a value of $2,704,760 against $2,770,086.
Banque Audi hit a record $26.250 from $25.625. Bank of Beirut was unchanged at $4.1875 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce fell to $19.250 from $19.625.
"In general, it was a normal trading day and we expect this to continue over the next week or so," said a broker who requested anonymity.
"The Banque Audi share might adjust a little bit. There was great demand at the $25 price and this is what pushed it to a record high," the broker said.
Solidere A fell to $10.5 from $10.75 with supply outstripping demand for the first time in several sessions, but Solidere B climbed to $11.125 from $10.875 in strong demand.
Of the four listed industrial firms, Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.281 on trade of 35,940 shares.
There was no trade in Ciments Blanc, Eternit and Uniceramic. --Beirut editorial (9611) 745307 745308 602057
